style: The poem will not survive on content but through voice. By voice I mean the style of thought, for which a style of speech never convincingly substitutes.
As quoted in "Poet Laureate: Louise Glück and the Public Face of a Private Artist" by Andrew Johnston, The New York Times (November 4, 2003)
My mission in life is not merely to survive, but to thrive; and to do so with some passion, some compassion, some humor, and some style.
Shared on her Facebook page, July 4, 2011

For Cioran the aphoristic style is less a principle of reality than a principle of knowing: that it’s the destiny of every profound idea to be quickly checkmated by another idea, which it itself has implicitly generated.
“‘Thinking against oneself’: reflections on Cioran,” p. 79
Switzerland is a small, steep country, much more up and down than sideways, and is all stuck over with large brown hotels built on the cuckoo clock style of architecture.
In The Toronto Star Weekly (4 March 1922)

Soviet-style communism failed, not because it was intrinsically evil but because it was flawed. It allowed too few people to usurp too much power. Twenty-first century market-capitalism, American style, will fail for the same reasons. Both are edifices constructed by the human intelligence, undone by human nature.
But to me, an exercise in style is not a superficial matter – our lives are also an exercise in style.
"Zadie Smith on NW – Guardian book club", The Guardian (1 August 2013).
stylistic: Yet I have no stylistic nobility. My head aches because my head aches. The universe aches me because my head aches.
